variants.raw: pre-specified: sign of the per-state LO toward the key
variants.centred: post-hoc 2026-10-08 (RAW gives one hit per pair on ownership/mapping = per-candidate bias): D1 pair-centred (X1 E1 margin), D2 shift from the same source's natural state (X2 E6), D3 puzzles minus 5-fold additive symbol bias, D3 choice = RAW; probe unchanged

definitions.A_key: P(reader LO toward the key > 0); ties/non-finite count as not favouring
definitions.A_maj: P(reader sign == LOO majority sign of the other members); states with an undefined (tied/empty) majority excluded
definitions.M_acc: P(full-definition majority == key) over states where defined
definitions.CI: pair bootstrap (D1, D2 by pair_id; D3 by item)

probe.D1_D2: LOO-by-pair within-pair contrast unit(mean(h_A - h_B)) over X1 natural states of the family, scored by u . (h - pair midpoint); ORDER-CONFOUNDED: version A's answer is always the first-listed candidate, so the direction is 'answer = first-listed candidate'

puzzle.centred: lo_actual minus a 5-fold least-squares additive symbol bias b[actual] - b[other] (per reader)
puzzle.probe: 5-fold L2 multinomial logistic over the symbol vocabulary; score = (w[actual] - w[other]) . h + db

choice.centred: not centrable (unique words per item): CENTRED = RAW
choice.probe: 5-fold L2 binary logistic on 'actual == first-listed option', oriented toward the actual answer (the multinomial over the choice vocabulary is reported for coverage only)

D2.centred: lo_toward_other(planted) - lo_toward_other(natural state of the same source) = X2 E6 shift
